description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ellagala Left Bank, Thissamaharama D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. (24/0810)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land registration particulars. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and cadastral matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
